sampling.order: Module filename, then small/medium/large; within stratum ascending (NCS SHA-256, resource name).
sampling.deduplication: Skip NCS hashes already in the targeted corpus or selected earlier, across all modules.
sampling.limitations: Only the six pinned module archives; scripts without packed NSS, empty scripts and scripts over 200 constants are outside this sampling frame. Labels and extractor output were not used for selection.
